invariants: Gateway verifies configured protected dispatch and exact source/recipe pins BEFORE requesting a provider job. Absent or rejected preflight returns local blocked/worker_unavailable and creates no provider job.
Provider queued state is pending intent, never proof of remote-worker availability. Policy.enabled and caller flags cannot establish dispatcher readiness.
Private immutable handoff deadline is min(job expires_at, created_at + 300 seconds). Only purpose-signed authenticated exact capture before that deadline can transition queued to running.
Status, protected context and capture derive or persist blocked/worker_unavailable after an unclaimed handoff deadline. Late capture cannot revive, recapture or rebase the job.

Gateway reports known dispatch failure immediately as blocked. Provider converges at deadline if protected failure route is unavailable. Indeterminate dispatch remains pending with read-only exact-job reconciliation; no duplicate dispatch, fabricated worker failure or automatic mutation retry.
No public readiness/worker endpoint. Gateway never receives registrar private keys. Existing staff wire and null-only consumer binding remain unchanged.
